dataset.title: Aging-related Alterations in mTOR Signaling Promote Platelet Hyperreactivity and Thrombosis

findings.message: The search identified an unusually small fraction of the MS2 spectra. Treat absence of a protein in this dataset as weak evidence. Producer's note: 21123/255570 = 8.27% of MS2 identified (S3)

The SDRF was used only for the runs it names that were searched: it names 2 file(s) the search did not use, whose rows were not used: ASLA-626_humanplatelet_TiO2phos_TMT_43pt2ug_25cm_120min_4ACN_20181128_OT, ASLA-626_humanplatelet_TiO2phos_TMT_43pt2ug_25cm_120min_4ACN_20181128_OT_20181128135556. sdrf_status is `partial`.

Some modifications on peptides shared between proteins were not written to ptm_sites for one or more of those proteins, because the peptide could not be located in that protein's sequence and the producer's residue spans cannot be paired with its accessions. Of the (PSM, protein) pairs affected: 11 named a protein that does not contain the stored peptide -- typically a PSM ambiguous between peptide sequences (level 4 or 5), where this protein carries a different candidate than the first, which is the one stored. Sites on the other proteins of the same PSMs are written. Counts are in bundle.json under protein_databases.

1 modification(s) could not be mapped to a UNIMOD accession or a mass, and are carried in ProForma as [Info:...] tags: UniProt:Omega-hydroxyceramide glutamate ester on Q. Their ptm_sites rows exist and carry modification_name, with modification null, so a query by name finds them and a query by UNIMOD accession will not.

1 of the 17 files were searched as acquired, not calibrated (their names in the search carry no `-calib`): `ASLA-626_humanplatelet_TiO2phos_TMT_43pt2ug_25cm_120min_10ACN_20181128_OT`. Their reporter values are the same kind of number; their identifications rest on uncalibrated precursor masses (QuantProject 066, rule 3).

PTM site occupancy was not stored: this is a TMT dataset, and MetaMorpheus computes intensity occupancy for label-free searches only; its count occupancy is per file, repeated on every channel (QuantProject DEF-OCC-INT). `ptm_stoichiometry` has no rows here because of that, not because no site was modified.

No per-run `metrics` row from results.txt for `psms_1pct` (17 of 17 runs), `peptides` (17 of 17 runs), `protein_groups` (17 of 17 runs). These counts were not written, which is not a count of zero. The search task sets `WriteIndividualFiles = false`, and MetaMorpheus writes results.txt's per-file PSM, peptide and protein-group lines only when it is true (before 1.1.14, MetaMorpheus #2955, its per-file precursor and MS2 lines too). PXReprise's QC payload counts each run's share of the whole search's 1% set instead, a different number (the FDR is the whole search's, not recomputed on each file), under names of its own (`source = 'qc_payload.json'`): `psms_1pct_whole_search` for 17 of the 17 runs, `peptides_1pct_whole_search` for 17 of the 17 runs, `protein_groups_1pct_whole_search` for 17 of the 17 runs.

dataset.summary: PXD049967 is a DDA isobaric dataset (Homo sapiens) with 17 runs, 10 samples and enrichment: phospho. It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.14. At 1% FDR the search reports 21,123 PSMs and 1,751 protein groups; 5,230 peptidoforms pass 1% on its q-value and notch q-value, and the repository holds 15,590 PTM sites for it. 5 open warnings about it are recorded.

organisms_are: `organisms` is the organism of the protein DATABASE the search used, not a statement about the samples. Sample annotation, where any exists, is in the catalog's `samples` and `sample_characteristics` tables.
